entities.text: RAM NIVAS Vs THE STATE OF M.P. AND OT
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Petitioner seeks a writ of habeas corpus.
It is contended in the petition that the petitioner's brother has been illegally and unlawfully detained by the State.

Petition mentions that the brother of petitioner has been detained in relation to FIR No.44 of 2024 registered at Police Station- Mahila Thana, Sehore for offence punishable under sections 376(3) and 506 of IPC and under section 5 and 6 of Prevention of Children from Sexual Office Act.

entities.text: Prevention of Children from Sexual Office Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Corpus has filed repeated bail application which were dismissed/withdrawn.

Learned counsel for the State submits that since the corpus has been incarcerated by following due process of law and, therefore, habeas corpus petition would not be maintainable.
Since none appears for the petitioner and a question of law arises for consideration, we deem it expedient to appoint Shri Aditya Adhikari, Senior Advocate as an Amicus Curiae in the matter to address on the question of law.
List for consideration on 15.05.2025.
 (SANJEEV SACHDEVA) 
 JUDGE   2 WP-15906-2025  rk.
